messages:
jia: Heads-up, ran a perf sweep on a customer's VPC cluster (4xT4 constrained) and noticed batch formation jitter—some requests sit >120ms waiting even though overall qps is low.

mike: Interesting. Is that the continuous batching path or the fallback queue?

jia: Continuous batching. It looks like our token-budget target per-queue isn't filling because KV-prefill requests steal headroom, so smaller interactive requests get deprioritized. repro trace attached (shortened):
```
# trace snippet
queue=A
enqueue: 12:03:01.123
prefill(kv)=true size=512
batch_emit delayed by 128ms due to token_budget_remaining<64
```

tara: That matches something I saw on a canary last week. On constrained hardware the kernel selection sometimes flips to slower code-paths for >512 seqs which increases per-token time, so the scheduler tries to keep batches smaller and ends up with more waits.

eva: Do we have the knob names handy to test? I can try nudging them on the customer's private control plane.

alex: There's vpc.batch.max_tokens_per_queue (default=4096), vpc.batch.soft_token_target (default=0.85), and vpc.batch.kv_prefill_priority (enum: high/normal/low). Also vpc.batch.max_wait_ms and vpc.batch.min_batch_tokens.

mike: Proposal: for constrained VPCs, set max_tokens_per_queue -> 2048, soft_token_target -> 0.7, and kv_prefill_priority -> low. That should reduce prefill steal and bias toward interactive latency. Lowering max_wait_ms from 100 to 60 also helps avoid long tail waits.

jia: I tried a local sim with those values and saw p95 latency drop ~40ms for short requests, but throughput dropped 6% and CPU on the T4 jumped slightly. Kernel selection trace showed we avoided kernel-switch for short sequences (which was the goal).

tara: Tradeoff sounds acceptable for enterprise interactive SLAs. Can we add an adaptive policy that auto-scales soft_token_target when GPU util < 40%? e.g., if idle then target=0.9 else 0.7.

alex: We have the telemetry to support that. Suggest we implement a simple feedback loop: every 30s calc util and adjust target in 0.05 steps, bounded [0.6,0.95]. Keep as opt-in for Private until validated.

eva: Quick test plan: 1) apply knob set on staging private cluster (4xT4) 2) run mixed shot/kv workload 3) capture traces + kernel selection flags 4) compare p50/p95 and token throughput. I can run tonight.

opsbot: deploybot: rollout vpc config to staging (ids: stg-vpc-13) scheduled at 23:15 UTC.

mike: Also capture KV cache hit-rate and cold-start prefill counts. If prefill_count > 20/min, lower kv_prefill_priority further or enable deferred prefill for idle GPUs.

jia: If this works, we should add a new preset: "private-interactive" with those defaults and doc the expected tradeoffs in the console.

tara: +1. Also add a guardrail: if kernel selection switches to fallback slower kernels more than 30% of time, emit an alert recommending smaller max_tokens_per_queue and investigating quantization config.

alex: I'll draft a small RFC with the preset, control-plane rollout steps, and the adaptive feedback loop logic. ETA tomorrow.

eva: Thanks — will post perf artifacts after test run. :thumbsup:
